purpose: X-C1 compatibility manifest for the canonical Lumen science ACP seam. Binds the method catalog to the pinned canonical source tuple and defines the compatibility rules consumers must obey. N/N-1 read compatibility: a v1 consumer may read responses produced by the pinned v2.2.0 engine; writes use only the current catalog schema. Unknown/new authority fields are rejected (deny_unknown_fields), never silently dropped.

rules.read_compat: read current; N-1 read compatibility only (v1 consumer vs pinned v2.2.0 engine)
rules.unknown_field_policy: reject — canonical params structs use serde deny_unknown_fields; consumers must not send fields absent from the catalog
rules.unknown_method_policy: reject — consumer registry and engine both fail closed
rules.deprecation: any v1 method removal requires a migration fixture plus one release-cycle notice in this manifest before removal
rules.rollback: composition rollback = previous LumenCoreSourceTupleV1 + previous catalog hash; API revision recorded per change
